relations.statement: Two-generation orthogonality of rows: v11*conj(v21) + v12*conj(v22) = 0 implies the quartet v11*v22*conj(v12)*conj(v21) has imaginary part 0 and real part -|v12|^2*|v22|^2
relations.hypotheses: v11 v12 v21 v22 are GaussRat; horth: add (mul v11 (conj v21)) (mul v12 (conj v22)) = 0

lemmas.statement: For Gaussian rationals with v11 conj(v21) + v12 conj(v22) = 0, the quartet v11 v22 conj(v12) conj(v21) has imaginary part 0 and real part -|v12|^2 |v22|^2.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: -- cited existing theorem RaveraDfmFiniteToContinuum.two_gen_cabibbo_artificial_cp_phase_zero; no new proof needed

near_misses.claim: Quartet imaginary part is zero without the orthogonality hypothesis v11 conj(v21) + v12 conj(v22) = 0
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Orthogonality is required; for arbitrary GaussRat entries the quartet can have nonzero imaginary part, so the claim is not hypothesis-free.
